About TaskFlow

Purpose, features, and a usage guide for the application.

What is TaskFlow?

TaskFlow is a lightweight, browser-based task management application built as part of the DevOps Fundamentals course (Spring 2026) at the University of Central Punjab. It provides a simple and clean interface to create, view, filter, and manage tasks without the complexity of a full backend or database.

The application is containerized using Docker and deployed automatically to Render via a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline, demonstrating a complete end-to-end DevOps workflow.

Key Features

  • 📊 Dashboard with task summary counts (total, pending, completed)
  • ➕ Add new tasks with title, description, due date, and priority
  • 📋 Task list with live filter buttons (All / Pending / Completed / Priority)
  • 🔍 Task detail view with options to mark complete or delete
  • ℹ️ About page with usage guide (you are here!)
  • 📱 Fully responsive design for mobile and desktop

How to Use TaskFlow

  1. Open the Dashboard

    Start at the Dashboard (index.html) to see a summary of all your tasks and quick navigation links.

  2. Add a Task

    Click "Add Task" in the navigation or the "+ New Task" button. Fill in the title, description, due date, and priority, then click Save.

  3. Browse All Tasks

    Go to "Task List" to see every task in a table. Use the filter buttons at the top to narrow down by status or priority level.

  4. View Task Details

    Click "View" on any task row to open its detail page. Here you can read the full description, see its priority and status, and take action.

  5. Complete or Delete a Task

    On the Task Detail page, click "Mark as Complete" to update the status, or "Delete Task" to remove it permanently.
